blocks.en: Fill in the Harakaat; write the {{term|analysis (Tarkeeb)}} and {{term|translation}} for the following Sentences
Indeed Allah {{label|was}} ever a watcher over you
Indeed the plotting of Shaytan {{label|was}} weak
{{label|I was}} a witness over them {{term|as long as I remained}} among them
It {{label|became}} dry stalks which the winds scatter
He {{label|became}} turning over his two palms

blocks.ar: أَوْصَانِيْ بالصّلاة و الزكاة {{term|ما دمتُ}} حَيّا
blocks.en: He enjoined upon me the prayer and the zakah {{term|as long as I remain}} alive

blocks.ar: إنَّ زيدا جالس علٰي شجرة {{term|لا يزال}} جِذْعها مثقوبا بطائر مِنْقَارهُ قَوِيّ يُسَمّٰى نَقَّارَ الخَشَب لِأَنَّه يَنقُر الخَشَب
blocks.en: Indeed Zayd is sitting on a tree whose trunk {{label|continues to be}} pierced by a bird whose beak is strong, called a woodpecker, because it pecks the wood
